title: Shrink acceptance omission metadata before blaming prompt overflow on criteria
outcome: Treat continuation/locator text as shrinkable brief context, or clearly attribute and document its share of the prompt floor, while preserving complete criteria and structured omissions.
acceptance: When the complete criteria fit the acceptance brief but its omission metadata would not, the independent and same-session briefs keep every criterion whole, show omissions as counts with a notice that details were not shown to fit the brief, and present no partial continuation; src/tests/acceptance_evaluation_omissions.rs acceptance_omissions_metadata_shrinks_before_a_fitting_contract_is_refused shows it.
The request response's evidenceOmissions still carries the bounded locator inventory and the full captured continuation; the same test asserts it.
docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md describes omission metadata as shrinkable prompt context.
The test passes in a full five-stage launcher gate on a master tree that contains the change, cited by run directory and launcher fingerprint.

completion.summary:
Verification-only closure. Since 4a0c2796 (an ancestor of master d8fdd2dc), acceptance omission metadata shrinks before a fitting contract is refused:
- the independent and same-session briefs keep every criterion whole, show omissions as counts with a "not shown to fit the brief" notice, and present no partial continuation;
- the response keeps the bounded locator inventory and the full captured continuation.
Covered by acceptance_omissions_metadata_shrinks_before_a_fitting_contract_is_refused, which passed in full gate test-9a715c89. Documented in docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md. Criteria concurred by Termal::Fable2 (f0c0d78d). Independent evaluation aebf2e6457144399abb0aa32082cc64e passed 4/4. No source change.
